common.errorGeneric: This couldn't be loaded right now.
common.notFoundText: The link may be old, or what you're looking for has moved.

nav.commandPlaceholder: Go to a page or search…

auth.forgotHint: Ask an administrator for a sign-in link. With it, you choose a new password.
auth.noAccount: No account? Ask whoever runs the server for an invitation.
auth.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.localOff: Password login is turned off on this server.
auth.noMethod: No login is set up. An administrator can set a password from the command line.
auth.setupIntro: This server has no users yet. Create the administrator account.
auth.setupClaimIntro: This server already has accounts and libraries, but no administrator can log in yet. Enter the code from the server's log, your username and a new password. An account that already exists keeps its collections and reading.
auth.setupCodeHint: In the server's log: docker compose logs api | grep "setup code". Restarting the api gives a new one.
auth.setupTaken: That account already has a password. Log in with it, or choose another username.
auth.devMode: AUTH_DISABLED is on: everyone is logged in as the dev user.
auth.passkeyFailed: The passkey couldn't be used. Try again, or log in with your password.

secondStep.title: Two-step verification
secondStep.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
secondStep.codeHint: Six digits from the app, for example Aegis, Google Authenticator or your password manager.
secondStep.recoveryHint: One of the recovery codes you saved. Each code works once.
secondStep.useApp: Use the code from the app
secondStep.wrong: Wrong code. Check that the phone's clock is right.
secondStep.wrongRecovery: Wrong or already used recovery code.

states.offline: You're offline. What has already loaded is shown.

home.createLibrary: Create a library in the admin pages
home.noLibrariesUser: An administrator needs to add a library.
home.newReleases_one: {{count}} followed series has a new release
home.newReleases_other: {{count}} followed series have a new release

book.missing: The file wasn't found in the last scan (since {{since}}). The book is hidden from readers until it's back.
book.kindleSent: Sent. It shows up on your Kindle in a moment.
book.kindleFailed: Couldn't send. Is there a Kindle address in Settings?
book.listHint: Separate several authors, genres and tags with commas.

series.unfollowed: You no longer follow the series.
series.rematchQueued: The series is being matched again in the background.
series.exportHint: Writes series.json in the series folder
series.noBooks: No books in this series yet.

library.emptyText: The library hasn't been scanned, or it's empty.

discover.intro: Suggestions from what you read. Like one and it becomes a request.
discover.emptyText: Ask for new suggestions and the AI looks at what you have read.
discover.failed: Couldn't get suggestions. AI recommendations may not be set up.

reader.noPages: No pages were found in this book. Try rescanning the library.
reader.unsupported: This format can't be read in the browser yet.
reader.rtlHint: Like manga: the next page is to the left.
reader.coverAloneHint: Starts the spreads after the cover, like the printed book.
reader.trimHint: Cuts blank edges around the page.
reader.tapsHint: Tap the edges to turn pages, the middle for the menu.
reader.keys: Keys: the arrow keys and space turn pages, Home and End go to the start and end, m shows the menu.
reader.goToPosition: Go to a place in the book
reader.searchHint: Search for words in the whole book.

searchPage.failed: The search couldn't run right now. The search index may be down for a while.
searchPage.fulltextHint: Only libraries that have been full-text indexed can be searched this way.

following.intro: Once a week Kodex checks whether series you follow have new releases. Follow a series with the bell on its card, or start reading it.
following.none: You don't follow any series yet
following.noneText: Tap the bell on a series card, or start reading a book in a series.

releases.intro: Upcoming and recently released issues in series you follow.
releases.noneText: Follow more series, or wait for the next weekly check.

collections.intro: Manual collections are hand-picked lists. Smart collections are a rule and fill themselves as new books match.
collections.name: Name
collections.manualHint: You add the books yourself afterwards.
collections.smartHint: It holds the books that match the rule, and updates itself.
collections.valueHint: e.g. Fantasy, or Silent Tides for story arcs
collections.advancedRule: Advanced rule (JSON, replaces the condition above)
collections.promptHint: e.g. cosy fantasy for winter evenings
collections.fromArcHint: Fetches an event's reading order from Comic Vine and links the issues you have. The rest show as missing.
collections.arcQueued: The reading order is being fetched in the background.
collections.deleteText: The collection is deleted. The books stay in the library.
collections.arcIntro: Story arc: the whole reading order, with missing issues greyed out.
collections.smartIntro: Smart collection: it updates as books match the rule.
collections.empty: No books in the collection yet
collections.owned: {{owned}} of {{total}} issues are in the library
collections.dragHint: Drag the handle or use the arrows.

requests.intro: Missing something in the library? Request it, and an administrator takes a look.
requests.newIntro: A series, an e-book or a manga. A link helps, for example to Comic Vine or MyAnimeList.
requests.invalid: The title is missing or looks wrong.

settings.passwordChanged: The password is changed. Your other logins are logged out.
settings.homeIntro: Which shelves are shown and in which order. Saved right away.

kindle_email.title: Send to Kindle
kindle_email.intro: The address your Kindle receives books at. Approve the server's sender among the “approved senders” at Amazon, or the mails are rejected. Comics are sent as PDF.
kindle_email.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.

ntfy_topic.title: New volume notifications
ntfy_topic.intro: A push when a new volume in a series you follow arrives. Subscribe to your own hard-to-guess topic in the ntfy app and enter the same topic here. Empty turns it off.
ntfy_topic.invalid: The topic may only contain letters, digits, - and _ (at most 64 characters).

keys.title: Apps and devices
keys.intro: Personal keys for OPDS readers, KOReader, Kobo and other apps. A key is shown only when it is created.
keys.opdsHelp: In an OPDS app (KOReader, Panels, Chunky, Moon+ Reader…): any username and an OPDS key as the password. The first address is OPDS 1.2 with page streaming, the second OPDS 2.0.
keys.kosyncHelp: Custom sync server in KOReader: log in as {{name}} with a KOSync key as the password.
keys.once: The key “{{name}}”. Copy it now, it isn't shown again.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeText: Apps that use the key stop working until they get a new one.
keys.legacy: You also have an OPDS token from Kodex v1. It works until you revoke it.
keys.legacyText: OPDS apps and KOReader that use it need a new key.
keys.koboHelp: The Kobo e-reader gets the EPUBs of a collection, as KEPUB, and the reading position goes both ways. Make a Kobo key and put the address in the device's .kobo/Kobo/Kobo eReader.conf under [OneStoreServices]. The server needs HTTPS.
keys.koboLine: The line for Kobo eReader.conf, under [OneStoreServices]:

kobo.title: Kobo e-readers
kobo.intro: Each Kobo key is an e-reader. It gets the EPUBs of the collection you choose; removing a book on the device takes it out of the collection.

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Matches Kodex wasn't sure of, regroup proposals and the log of automatic decisions. Biggest first.
review.allDoneText: Every match is decided. New ones arrive after the next scan.
review.regroupIntro: The files no longer fit the series. Proposed move:
review.copyGolden: Copy as a line for the golden corpus
review.keys: Keys: j/k move, 1–3 choose, n no match, d skip, s search, u undo, a/r accept or reject a regroup. Data from Comic Vine, Metron, MangaDex, AniList and other sources.

adminLibraries.intro: Libraries are folders under LIBRARIES_ROOT. A scan finds new and changed files; matching links series to Comic Vine, Metron, MangaDex and other sources.
adminLibraries.createFirst: Create the first library with the button above.
adminLibraries.readOnlyHint: Kodex never changes the files (no uploads or write-back).
adminLibraries.writeBackHint: Writes matched metadata into the files (ComicInfo.xml).
adminLibraries.writeBackQueued: Metadata is being written to the files in the background.
adminLibraries.pathHint: Relative to LIBRARIES_ROOT on the server.
adminLibraries.invalid: Check the name, path and type.

jobs.intro: What the workers are doing now and did in the last day. Refreshes by itself.

duplicates.intro: The same book more than once. Exact duplicates have the same pages; similar ones have the same number in the same series and nearly the same cover.
duplicates.exactHint: The first in each group is the one the others point at.
duplicates.similarHint: Different files that are probably the same issue, such as different scans.

pageFlags.intro: Pages readers flagged. Delete hides the page in the reader without touching the file; keep closes the flag.

done.deleted: The page is hidden in the reader.

missing.intro: Books whose file wasn't found in the last scan. They're hidden from readers until the file is back, unless you show them anyway.

users.intro: Accounts on the server and their roles. Give a new user a sign-in link, and they choose their own password.
users.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep it. A new password logs the user out everywhere.
users.passwordHint: Without a password, the user logs in with a sign-in link or single sign-on.
users.disableHint: The user is logged out and can't log in.

roleHints.admin: Everything, including libraries, matching and users.
roleHints.user: Reads, follows series and sends requests.

link.title: Sign-in link
link.hint: Valid for three days and once, for choosing a password.

reset.title: Two-step verification and passkeys
reset.hint: For someone who lost their phone.
reset.confirmText: Two-step verification is turned off, passkeys are removed and the user is logged out everywhere. The password stays.

integrations.intro: Services Kodex can use. They're set up with environment variables in the server's .env; the values are never shown here.

oidc.name: OpenID Connect
oidc.what: Single sign-on with an identity provider, for example Authentik, Keycloak or Authelia.

comicvine.name: Comic Vine
comicvine.what: Series and issues for matching, new releases and story arcs.

metron.name: Metron
metron.what: Open comics database, used for matching.

kindle.name: Send to Kindle (SMTP)
kindle.what: Email that sends books to e-readers.

flaresolverr.name: FlareSolverr
flaresolverr.what: Gets past Cloudflare for some sources.

progress_sync.name: Central sync server
progress_sync.what: Shares reading progress with another Kodex server.

stats_key.name: Statistics key
stats_key.what: Lets a dashboard read the statistics.

importPage.intro: Bringing things in: sorting the intake, a pull list as CSV, and reading lists. Files are uploaded per library under
importPage.sortIntro: Analyses what's in the intake (the library of type Mixed) and moves it to the right library.
importPage.noIntake: There is no intake library (type Mixed).
importPage.sortNone: Nothing is waiting to be sorted
importPage.csvIntro: A CSV of titles (preferably with numbers) is matched against the library and becomes a collection.
importPage.csvUnreadable: The file couldn't be read. Does it have a title or series column?
importPage.cblIntro: Search the reading lists in the CBL catalog and make a story arc collection of one.
importPage.locgTitle: Event from League of Comic Geeks
importPage.locgIntro: Paste an event's address and its reading order becomes a story arc collection.

match.title: Match the book
match.failed: The match couldn't be saved. The source may be rate limiting; try again in a moment.

seriesOps.splitTitle_one: Make {{count}} book a series of its own
seriesOps.splitTitle_other: Make {{count}} books a series of their own
seriesOps.mergeTitle: Merge other series into this one

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.intro: Choose a password for your Kodex account. The link works once.
welcome.invalidIntro: It has been used, is too old or is wrong. Ask an admin for a new one.

security.title: Login and security
security.intro: Log in without a password using a passkey, and protect your password with a second step.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Log in with a fingerprint, face or PIN on your phone or computer, or with a security key.
passkeys.already: This device already has a passkey for your account.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.removeText: You can't log in with it any more. It stays on the device until you remove it there.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.intro: After the password, a code from an authenticator app is needed. Logging in with a passkey or single sign-on needs no second step.
twoStep.setupIntro: Scan the code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password or Bitwarden) and enter the code it shows.
twoStep.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twoStep.codesIntro: A recovery code logs you in if your phone is lost. Each code works once, and they are shown only now.
twoStep.fileHeader: Recovery codes for Kodex ({{host}}). Each code works once.
twoStep.codeNeeded: Confirm with a code from the app or a recovery code.

provider.title: Login with {{name}}
provider.intro: Link your account to log in with {{name}} too.
provider.linked: Your account is linked: you can log in with {{name}}.
provider.unlinkText: You log in with your password or a passkey instead.

readingStats.title: Statistics
readingStats.intro: Your reading over the last year, from the reading journal on all your devices.
readingStats.pagesNote: Last year, in comics, manga and PDF
readingStats.perMonthIntro: Books you finished, over the last twelve months.
readingStats.daysIntro_one: You read on {{count}} day in the last year.
readingStats.daysIntro_other: You read on {{count}} days in the last year.

appLogin.title: Log in to the Kodex app
appLogin.intro: The app on {{device}} wants to log in as {{name}}.
appLogin.what: The app gets a key of its own, which you see and can revoke under Settings → Apps and devices.
appLogin.invalid: The link is incomplete. Start logging in again from the app.
appLogin.failed: The app couldn't be approved. Try again from the app.

trackers.title: Trackers
trackers.intro: What you read in Kodex goes to your lists at MangaUpdates, Kitsu, AniList and MyAnimeList, wherever you read it: the web, the app, KOReader or a Kobo. Every quarter of an hour or when you ask, and only forward.
trackers.noSecret: The server needs a SECRET_KEY before trackers can be connected (an admin sets it in .env).
trackers.needsClient: The server needs a registered {{name}} client (an admin sets it in .env).
trackers.passwordNote: The password isn't kept; Kodex gets a token from {{name}} and keeps it encrypted.
trackers.howItWorks: The highest number you have finished is sent, never less than what the service already has.

missingIssues.automatic: Once an admin approves the request, the number is fetched and added to the series on its own.
missingIssues.manual: An admin sees the request under Requests.
